verdict.rationale: The product's own SIP trunking integration lets existing PBX or SIP phone systems route calls to ElevenLabs agents, so it has native telephony connectivity for calls coming in through a customer's own infrastructure. Nothing in the evidence shows provisioning phone numbers, placing outbound calls, or driving telephony through the API. missing for 10: phone-number provisioning, outbound calling, API-driven call control, explicit inbound-call documentation beyond SIP routing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can provision phone numbers and run both inbound and outbound calls through the platform's API

citations.quote: Connect your Private Branch Exchange (PBX) or SIP-enabled phone system to ElevenLabs' voice AI platform
Route calls to AI agents without changing your existing phone infrastructure
This integration enables all customers to use their existing phone systems while leveraging ElevenLabs' advanced voice AI capabilities.
